name: hcapp_setBulkEventAttendence
description: Sets attendance state for multiple hashers at once. Accepts a comma-separated list of user UUIDs, parses via STRING_SPLIT+TRY_CAST, updates existing HasherEventMap records (UPDATE) and creates missing ones (INSERT). After updating, calls nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers and delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData.

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hasher UUIDs. VARCHAR not NVARCHAR.

parameters.name: attendenceState
parameters.description: Must be between 20-40 inclusive. Validated before auth check.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2 for null userId/eventId/invalid attendenceState/null hasherIds. errorType=3 for auth failure.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: 'N records updated, M records inserted, ' — note trailing comma.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState, RsvpState=3 — for matching hashers
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — for hashers not yet at event

codeSmells.detail: Should be NVARCHAR. UUID strings are ASCII-safe but the type is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase.
UPDATE and INSERT run outside a transaction. Partial failure leaves some users updated and others not.
The ParsedGuids CTE is declared separately for the UPDATE and INSERT blocks. SQL Server doesn't allow sharing a CTE between statements, but the duplication adds noise.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
